description: This Java source file defines the QueueFragment class, which is a Fragment that displays and manages the media playback queue in an Android media browsing application. It handles connection to a MediaBrowser service, receives callbacks for playback state and queue changes, updates the UI accordingly, and provides controls for media playback actions such as play, pause, skip to next, and skip to previous.

classes.name: QueueFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that shows the media playback queue, manages connection to media service, updates UI on media session state changes, and provides playback controls.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes UI elements, sets click listeners, and establishes the media browser connection.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Connects the media browser when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters callbacks and disconnects the media browser when the fragment is paused.

methods.name: onPlaybackStateChanged
methods.description: Updates the UI and internal state based on the current playback state.

methods.name: playMedia
methods.description: Triggers media playback via transport controls.

methods.name: pauseMedia
methods.description: Pauses media playback via transport controls.

methods.name: skipToPrevious
methods.description: Skips to the previous media item.

methods.name: skipToNext
methods.description: Skips to the next media item.
